Ramírez had shown the unweighted version fails. 87 pages, no Lean.
For every real shift gamma and every psi: N -> [0, inf) with sum phi(q) psi(q)/q = infinity, almost every x satisfies ||q x - gamma|| < psi(q) for infinitely many q (numerators unrestricted).
'Weak' version (unrestricted numerators, totient-weighted divergence), not the coprime-numerator form.
